# Evidence of Life — llms.txt
# Compact map for coding agents. Prefer this file before deep exploration.
# Full index: /llms-full.txt | Human docs: /README.md | Agent rules: /AGENTS.md

> Evidence of Life is a private personal life-management SPA: plan the day, capture moments, track dues/habits, map places, sync Google Calendar. Not therapy.

## Stack
- Frontend: Vite 5, React 18, TypeScript 5, Tailwind 3, shadcn/ui, TanStack Query, React Router
- Backend: Supabase Auth + Postgres (RLS) + Storage + Deno edge functions
- Tests: Vitest (`npm test`), Playwright demo smoke (`npm run test:e2e`), Deno auth tests (`npm run test:security`)
- Dev server: http://localhost:8080 (demo: /demo-app)

## Critical constraints
- SWC does not type-check — always run `npm run typecheck` after TS changes
- Do not invent features, APIs, or metrics
- Do not commit secrets; only `.env.example` is tracked
- Feature PRs must not change migrations / RLS / auth / storage policies
- Verify UI claims on `/demo-app` before reporting success

## Entry points
- src/main.tsx — bootstrap
- src/App.tsx — routes, auth gates
- src/pages/Index.tsx — authenticated shell
- src/pages/PublicDemo.tsx — synthetic demo
- src/pages/Landing.tsx — marketing landing
- src/integrations/supabase/client.ts — Supabase client (requires VITE_SUPABASE_*)

## Core domains
- src/hooks/useAuth.tsx — session / demo mode
- src/hooks/useTodos.ts — plan tasks + timers + demo data
- src/hooks/useMoments.ts — moments CRUD
- src/hooks/useDues.ts / useDueReminders.ts — dues
- src/hooks/useLifeReminder.ts — browser + optional ntfy life-capture nudges
- src/lib/ntfy.ts — ntfy topic URL normalize + publish
- src/hooks/usePlaces.ts — map places
- src/hooks/useGoogleCalendar.ts — calendar sync client
- src/lib/momentPhotos.ts — private storage paths + signed URLs
- src/lib/autoSchedule.ts — scheduling helpers
- src/components/views/PlanView.tsx / PlanTimelineView.tsx — plan UI
- src/components/views/TodayView.tsx — today / recap
- src/components/views/MapView.tsx — map
- src/components/StorageImage.tsx — signed photo display

## Edge functions (supabase/functions/)
- _shared/auth.ts — requireUser, OAuth state HMAC, image-proxy allowlist
- google-calendar-auth|callback|sync — Calendar OAuth
- geo, smart-input, link-preview, image-proxy, life-replay
